display.title: Kill the The Harbinger
display.subtitle: Boss kill
description: A mechanical boss in the Ancient Factory, a large structure that can generate in caves or deep underground. Bring a good pickaxe and light sources.
It is very hard to spot by chance, so the practical way to find it is an Eye of Mech, used like an Eye of Ender.
The kill itself is tracked once, in the Bosses chapter. This quest completes after that one; just tick it off.
